d: The Atlantic Bluefin are starting to migrate out, so the local fleet races to find any edge they can.
With only two weeks left on the season, just one fish is not enough for the Gloucester captains.
Gloucester's reigning champion Dave Carraro starts the fishing season with a $20,000 lead over his rival.
The captains race against each other - and an oncoming storm - to land their final fish of the season.
The fishermen set out for Jeffrey's Ledge in hopes of catching the first fish of the Bluefin Tuna Season.
It's week two of the season and the captains and their crews, from rookies to old pros, get put to the test.
Bad weather threatens to end the fishing week, but some boats decide to take on Mother Nature's wrath.
